Contributing to FunMel

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Report bugs with a reproducible example, the FunMel version and sessionInfo().

From the package source folder, run:

devtools::document()
testthat::test_local()
devtools::check()

Build the documentation website with:

source("inst/scripts/build_website.R")

Check the tutorials, treatment/control matching, metadata preservation and figure exports before submitting changes. Keep private data and compiled objects out of Git.

Developed by Mitra Ghotbi.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
